events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 56 years since the iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Jimi Hendrix, 56 years on. His groundbreaking guitar work and electrifying stage presence continue to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released 57 years ago today in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Flashback
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this iconic album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic voice of Oasis and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Groove
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that undeniable swagger to British music.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that continues to resonate around the world.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod 25 years ago today in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Quarter Century
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It's 25 years since Apple dropped this game-changer, putting 1,000 songs in your pocket and changing music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic 007 film franchise.

angles.name: Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Licence to thrill since 1962. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Laughs
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released 58 years ago today in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Flashback
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album' upon the world. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the unparalleled talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Flashback
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles gifted us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw the Fab Four push new creative boundaries.

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the world tragically lost John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years after his passing. His legacy of peace and powerful music lives on.
